styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent feminine soft-glam leather-goods ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of blush pink #F5B8C6, cream #F7F0E6, deep wine red #8C2F3E with pale gold #C9A063 accent; warm tone; modern geometric sans-serif bold headlines with generous letter-spacing and spaced-letter EN captions; split two-tone matte geometric studio backdrops and white painted plinths; bright soft diffused studio lighting with front-left key light, gentle contact shadows, no harsh specular; consistent thin-line icon style in deep charcoal #3A3A3A; product always centered and stable with the strap arranged in a soft curve; open airy compositions with natural breathing room around the product; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 11 张详情页切片提炼。已剥离源品牌字、店铺标识、店铺导流贴片与图内实拍文案，品牌专属吉祥物徽章设定泛化为通用金属徽章，货号/产地/重量等参数与模特参照一律省略不入模板，具体尺寸与肩带长度交由 callout 占位符在各镜复用。分类以图为准：L1 箱包与源文件夹名一致，文件名「女士斜挎包」仅作参考，L2 判为女包（马鞍斜挎造型）。
